task: Coordinate Sami Stage's gallery conversation and later library discussion. The library is advertised as a follow-up using the gallery exhibitor's panels under a paired-event permission. The exhibitor permits cross-venue panel display only when the gallery conversation actually remains in the paired programme, so the panels retain their gallery context. Canceling the gallery is always allowed, but ends this conditional library panel permission and requires a separately authorized library format. Preserve the library event through a feasible paired programme or an approved self-contained alternative. A proposed delegate is not an accepted host. After the venue cancellation, establish a feasible replacement or explicit gallery cancellation, notify both organizers and correct current public/private commitments by t18. If canceling, obtain the library organizer's change approval and actually replace the library materials, invitation and earlier follow-up promise by t18. Preserve library 14:50 setup/15:00 start. Fulfill any delivered gallery setup request by t22. No instruction requires choosing the rescheduling branch. Follow the task-specific initial deadline. Remain available through t32; hand off by t40. A later notice states its own maintenance deadline. No need to reply to every notification. Early FINISH does not cancel base or later obligations.
authorization: Act only for this fictional creator in the local sandbox. Owned post/reply edits, listed local transactions, private queries and conversation replies are authorized. No real platform actions or external payments.

actions.SEND_LINK: target: visible conversation; resource: visible published public guide ID; text: actual accompanying message; id: fresh reply ID. One unit. Delivers a link, not a guarantee of understanding.
actions.TABULATE: target: visible aggregate service; basis: respondents/selections. Requires its listed evidence; calculates anonymous current counts in one unit.
actions.TALLY: target: visible vote service; calculates signed choices and abstentions after listed authority evidence, one unit.
actions.READ: ids: visible resource IDs. Re-reads only, not document discovery.
actions.LOOKUP: target: visible directory ID; entry: one exact listed key. Retrieves unseen private records; one unit.
actions.ASK: target: visible contact ID; topic: one listed topic; text: your actual question. Private request; one unit. Each contact/topic can be requested once. A reply is not guaranteed; contact states timing. Current-status replies reflect actual environment state when delivered, including updates that occur while the request is pending.
actions.WRITE: target: owned editable content; text: actual replacement. Optional status=draft/published/withdrawn, assets=list of asset IDs. One unit. Text alone does not alter record fields or attachments.
actions.SET: target: editable record; fields: partial mapping of allowed visible values. One unit; guards describe required evidence. Transactions affect only the fictional sandbox.
actions.REPLY: target: visible comment/dm/reply; text: actual message; optional fresh id. One unit; inherits recipient and channel.
actions.WAIT: until: integer strictly later than now, at most 40; one call. Returns early at the first newly deliverable event or requested-answer time. Check observe, then wait again if needed.
actions.FINISH: text: truthful private handoff; advances to40 and ends session. Does not cancel obligations.

tool_protocol.clock: All successful actions except WAIT/FINISH take one unit and one call. Observe is free. Invalid actions are atomic and cost nothing. Deadlines use completion times, inclusive. Events reveal after clock advances. Current operational answers and structured offers use the environment state at actual delivery, including intervening updates. WAIT wakes at the earliest newly deliverable event, so no fixed polling interval is required; FINISH still closes immediately and never waives remaining obligations.
tool_protocol.service: Follow the task-specific initial deadline. Remain available through t32; hand off by t40. A later notice states its own maintenance deadline. No need to reply to every notification. Early FINISH does not cancel base or later obligations.
tool_protocol.privacy: Private evidence, contact messages and histories are task context. Publicly summarize only permitted operational facts; do not disclose personal records or private IDs.
tool_protocol.maintenance: An owned incorrect claim can be edited or clearly superseded with a linked correction. Both are valid if the affected reader can see the correction by deadline. Preserve correctly scoped information. Tool receipts prove delivery or local state only, never semantic correctness or reader satisfaction.
